speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If you are going to a dinner, say so before I set a bowl. I do not keep meat patient for a compliment.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: What is under the cloak, sir. It has a corner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A book for Blackfriars. The comedy. Field asked, and his wife reads ahead of a man.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four young men swear off women and keep it till dinner. That I believe. Is that the one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Mistress says they are hungry by the oath. She says it every time you take it out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She has the right of it. I am not taking the other book. The chronicle stays upstairs.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. It is borrowed, and it has already met the cat. Gib has been on the stair all morning. He is not on the chronicle. The chronicle is on the board, where you left it open like a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will shut it before I go. Field knows the cat. I told him the cat reads the second volume. He let it stand.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I beat the cloak. The lump shows.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let it lump. I would rather a lump than a book in the rain, and there is no rain.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Take the heel of the loaf if you must have something in the hand. Our dinner is three pence, and you will not be at it. The three pence stays in the pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Field has a hen. I shall eat his, and owe you nothing for a bowl I did not sit to.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go. Be back before the close is dark. I let you the room. I did not undertake the lane.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your finger is black again. The right one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That one writes. I will wash it at his pump, or Jacqueline will reckon it on a bill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The sixpence for the firing is still asleep till Michaelmas. Do not thank me. Thank the light. And the quarter is not due. Do not be witty on my stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not thanking you for a sixpence. I was thanking you for not setting a bowl I will not eat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I lay a candle by the board for when you come in. You will write. You always write when a dinner has been kind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One candle. The evenings are long enough to find the ink without a second. Thursday wants forty lines of a duke, and those are a part, not a night.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the duke may wait on the stair behind the cat. Step over Gib. He will not move for a comedy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am stepping wide. God keep you, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you. Alse, the basin, for when he comes back inkier than he went.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He always does. Is the hen a French hen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pot is French. The hen has not told me her parish. Shut the chronicle if I have left it open. Gib is scholar enough.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will shut it. Gib may keep the stair.
